title: The At Risk detail table's order and its 500-row limit
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. A workplace with several at-risk customers (and, if reachable, a workplace exceeding 500 at-risk customers) - seed backdated single-invoice customers.
custom_steps:
1. Expand the At Risk Customers tile and confirm the table lists every at-risk customer, ordered by trailing-twelve-month revenue highest first, with customer name as the tiebreaker.
2. Where a workplace exceeds 500 at-risk customers, confirm the table shows the first 500 in that order and says 'Showing 500 of N at-risk customers', while the headline still counts every one (it never truncates silently).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The At Risk Customers tile expands to a table of every at-risk customer, ordered by trailing-twelve-month revenue highest first (name as tiebreaker); a 500-row safety cap shows the first 500 and says "Showing 500 of N at-risk customers" while the headline still counts every one, never truncating silently.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9578 (S6 — Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S6; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R8: “The At Risk Customers tile expands to the At Risk Customers table. The table is ordered by each customer's trailing-twelve-month revenue, highest first, with the customer name as the tiebreaker, so the largest amount at risk reads first. The table lists every at-risk customer. A safety cap of 500 rows applies: if a workplace ever exceeds it, the table shows the first 500 in that order and says so on screen, reading "Showing 500 of N at-risk customers", while the headline still counts every one. The table never truncates silently, because a table that stops short while the headline counts more is a defect: the two then disagree.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
